PR O J E C T : G E N E R A T I V E A I B O T S

• Developed 3 distinct bots: HR Policy Bot: Assisted employees with HR policy-related queries. Product Catalogue Bot: Provided detailed information on company products. Competitor Analysis Bot: Enabled managers to analyze competitor data, focusing on rivals like Tata AIG and Bajaj Allianz.

• Implemented LLM models: Gemini-1.5-Flash-001 and Text-Bison-32k. Conducted data ingestion (PDFs/Docs) into Google BigQuery to train the AI models. • Prompt engineered and created the following APIs in the backend.

▪ Bot Response API for conversational output.

▪ Suggested Questions API for dynamic follow-up queries.

▪ Feedback API for continuous learning and model improvement.


• PR O J E C T : P E H C H A A N

• Pehchaan is a KYC verification system, that caters to a customer base exceeding 10 million.

• Added features like OCR for document data scanning, a human verification dashboard for verification of manual entries, and API integration for partner companies like TVS, and Maruti.

• Utilized Signzy APIs to improve verification processes and retrieved data from the CKYC repository

• Customers with data in the CKYC repository were verified instantly, while those submitting manual entries experienced a turnaround time (TAT) of 12 hours for approval or rejection.

• Our timely project delivery, in line with the IRDAI’s KYC guidelines for insurance from January 1, 2023, prevented disruptions to the company’s daily sales operations.

• Technologies: MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js).


• PR O J E C T : C H A S E • Chase is an in-house application created for managing and investigating fraud claim cases. • Developed two separate applications: one for internal investigators across various hierarchies and another for vendors to gather and input data from incident sites. • Engineered logic to facilitate the seamless progression of claim cases through different investigative stages, with automatic adjustments in case hierarchy and invoice processing based on claim amounts and investigator inputs. • Achieved a 30% reduction in costs and enhanced investigation accuracy by 55%. • Technologies: PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). • Please note that MITSGLOBAL was the hiring company, while HDFCERGO was the client throughout the engagement.

1. Led frontend development using React.js and Redux for various projects, Spearheaded the design and implementation of interactive and user-friendly interfaces, resulting in a 30% increase in user engagement.
  2. Optimized code for scalability and maintainability by Refactoring existing codebase to enhance readability and efficiency, minimized overall bundle size, and eased future updates.

• P R O J E C T : E-T R U C K I N G S O F T

• E-TruckingSoft is a platform that helps truck owners manage and optimize the utilization of their fleet.

• Improved project performance by 80%, and reduced re-rendering issues using React Profiler, Memo, and batch updates.

• Implemented complex logic and features, including interactive forms, maps, tables, and dynamic graphs on the frontend for enhanced data visualization.

• Technologies: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, Ant Design, Azure.

1. Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform from the ground up, including both the admin dashboard and the customer-facing website, and deployed it on AWS (EC2, S3).

• Successfully delivered portfolio and business websites for clients on Upwork, increasing their sales and customer engagement.

• Technologies: MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js).
